newsitem.title: TAIWAN: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - June 20.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - June 20.

text.p: These are the leading stories in the Taiwan press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
CHINA TIMES - United Microelectronics to invest T$500 billion in wafer plants over 10 years
National Assembly to extend session to discuss constitutional amendments
UNITED DAILY NEWS - President Lee Teng-hui supports abolishing provincial government
Thirty-seven companies apply to set up plants in southern Tainan science park
LIBERTY TIMES - Stock market sets record high turnover of T$251 billion
Ruling and opposition parties to focus on abolition of provincial government in making constitutional amendment proposals.
COMMERCIAL TIMES - Analysts split on whether Hong Kong stocks will rise or fall following colony's reversion to Chinese rule
Morgan Stanley gives optimistic forecast for Hong Kong stocks after handover
ECONOMIC DAILY NEWS - Government to streamline tariff system in six months
Semiconductor industry sees continuing boom in second half
